name: confirmation
description: Human-in-the-loop approval gate for agent actions. Pauses execution until the user approves or rejects.
designIntent: Make destructive or consequential tool calls require explicit user consent.

props.name: title
props.description: Summary of the action requiring approval.

props.name: description
props.description: Detail: affected resource or risk note.

props.name: toolName
props.description: Tool/action name shown as mono text.

examples.title: Gate a destructive tool
examples.code: <Confirmation title="Delete all files?" toolName="delete_all" onApprove={run} onReject={cancel} />

antiPatterns.title: Do not auto-approve after timeout
antiPatterns.explanation: Silent approval defeats the safety purpose; keep waiting or fail explicitly.

accessibility.implementation: Pending state renders role=alertdialog labeled by the title.
